result.topic_en: A blank receipt template (in German) for salary drawn from the Royal University Treasury at Hanover in gold and Courant, followed by a list of books noted in 1839.
result.transcription:

UniversitätsCasse zu Hannover
mir beigelegten jährlichen Besoldung von
rß Gold und rß Courant

ich hiedurch quittirend
g
